title: XNOR Exclusive-NOR Gate (IC 74266)
summary: An XNOR gate (Exclusive-NOR) produces a HIGH (1) output IF AND ONLY IF the inputs are EQUAL (both 0 or both 1). It is also known as a Digital Equivalence Gate or Comparator.

images.title: ANSI XNOR Symbol
images.caption: IEEE Symbol for 2-Input XNOR Gate with output bubble.

images.title: Breadboard Wiring Diagram (IC 74266)
images.caption: Complete IC 74266 Quad 2-Input XNOR Gate breadboard wiring setup: +5V to Pin 14, GND to Pin 7, Inputs G & H to Pins 1 & 2 (1A & 1B), Output Y1 from Pin 3 (1Y).

working_principle:
The XNOR gate evaluates Y = (A ⊕ B)' = A·B + A'·B'. Output is 1 when A=0, B=0 OR A=1, B=1.

⚡ IC 74266 Breadboard Wiring Guide:
1. Power Supply (VCC): Connect Red Wire from +5V Power Terminal to IC Pin 14.
2. Ground (GND): Connect Black Wire from GND Power Terminal to IC Pin 7.
3. Gate 1 Logic Inputs (1A & 1B): Connect Cyan Wire from Input Terminal G to IC Pin 1, and Cyan Wire from Input Terminal H to IC Pin 2.
4. Gate 1 Logic Output (1Y): Connect Green Wire from IC Pin 3 to Output Terminal Y1 (or Y0).
5. Power Switch: Turn Trainer Kit Power ON to evaluate equivalence logic.
applications: Digital Equality Comparators (Output 1 when A equals B)
advantages: Directly tests equality between binary signals
disadvantages: IC 74266 features open-collector outputs requiring external pull-up resistors in real hardware
common_mistakes: Connecting input wires to Pin 3 (which is an output pin) instead of Pins 1 & 2.
Forgetting pull-up resistors on IC 74266 open-collector outputs in physical lab circuits.
quick_notes: Pin 14 is VCC (+5V Power), Pin 7 is GND (0V Ground).
XNOR outputs HIGH (1) when inputs are equal (00 or 11).

viva_questions.q: Why is an XNOR gate called a Digital Comparator?
viva_questions.a: Because its output is HIGH (1) whenever both inputs are equal in value (both 0 or both 1).

viva_questions.q: What are the IC 74266 pin connections for Gate 1?
viva_questions.a: Pin 1 (1A) and Pin 2 (1B) are inputs; Pin 3 (1Y) is the output.

interview_questions.q: How can you construct an XNOR gate using only NOR gates?
interview_questions.a: Pass inputs A and B into a 4-NOR gate network.
